# metronome Provider

Manages the pricing configuration of a [Metronome](https://docs.metronome.com) account: billable metrics, products, rate cards, rates, threshold notifications and custom field keys. Customers, contracts, commits and credits are created by an application at run time and are not managed here.

Most of Metronome's configuration cannot be deleted, and much of it cannot be changed: destroying a resource **archives** it, and changing an attribute Metronome holds fixed **replaces** the resource. Each resource says what it does.

A token belongs to one environment of the account (sandbox or production); so does everything it creates.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    metronome = {
      source = "r33drichards/metronome"
    }
  }
}

# The token comes from the environment variable METRONOME_BEARER_TOKEN, which
# keeps it out of the configuration and the plan. It belongs to one
# environment of the account (sandbox or production), and so does everything
# this configuration creates.
provider "metronome" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `bearer_token` (String, Sensitive) An API token, created in the Metronome app under Developer, API tokens. May be set with the environment variable `METRONOME_BEARER_TOKEN`, which keeps it out of the configuration.
- `endpoint` (String) Base URL of the API. May be set with the environment variable `METRONOME_ENDPOINT`. Defaults to `https://api.metronome.com`.
